runner_notes: Mixed spec. Python mutants (no test_command key) run the global test_command from the repo root with `tests` appended in place of the last path, optionally narrowed by `run_only` (a -k expression; a mutant that survives the narrowed run MUST be re-run over its full `tests` files before it is declared survived). Site mutants carry their own test_command and `cwd: site`: run them from site/ (npx vitest run <files>); `file` paths still resolve relative to this directory. Revert each mutated file with `git checkout -- <file>` before the next mutant. `expect` is the test whose failure is the kill, or `survived` with the `why`.

mutants.find:
log_report = scorecard_module.verified_log_report(conn)
    card = scorecard_module.build_scorecard(conn, log_report)

    rows = _load_verification_rows(conn)
    scored = score(rows, by=("station", "variable", "lead_day", "season"))
    by_station = _station_stats(scored)

    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cities_dir = out_dir / "cities"
    cities_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    scorecard_cities_dir = out_dir / "scorecard_cities"
    scorecard_cities_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

    window: dict[str, object] | None = None
    if card.window is not None:
        window = {
            "days": scorecard_module.WINDOW_DAYS,
            "basis": scorecard_module.WINDOW_BASIS,
            "start": card.window[0].isoformat(),
            "end": card.window[1].isoformat(),
        }

    city_index_entries: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    for icao in sorted(registry):
        station = registry[icao]
        raw_stats = by_station.get(icao, [])
        summary = build_summary(raw_stats)
        rounded_stats = [round_stat(stat) for stat in raw_stats]
        typical_miss = build_typical_miss(raw_stats)
        rounded_typical_miss = {
            variable: _round2(value) for variable, value in typical_miss.items()
        }
        label = title_case_label(station.label)

        _write_json(
            cities_dir / f"{icao}.json",
            {
                "schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION,
                "icao": station.icao,
                "label": label,
                "stats": rounded_stats,
                "typical_miss": rounded_typical_miss,
            },
        )

        _write_json(
            scorecard_cities_dir / f"{icao}.json",
            {
                "schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION,
                "icao": station.icao,
                "label": label,
                "window": window,
                "stats": [
                    round_scorecard_stat(stat) for stat in card.stations.get(icao, [])
                ],
            },
        )

        city_index_entries.append(
            {
                "icao": station.icao,
                "label": label,
                "lat": station.lat,
                "lon": station.lon,
                "climate_region": station.climate_region,
                "summary": summary,
            }
        )

    _write_json(
        out_dir / "city_index.json",
        {"schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION, "cities": city_index_entries},
    )
    _write_json(
        out_dir / "completeness.json",
        {"schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION, "stations": []},
    )

    _write_json(
        out_dir / "scorecard.json",
        {
            "schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION,
            "window": window,
            "intervals": scorecard_module.intervals_block(),
            "log": card.log,
            "national": [round_scorecard_stat(stat) for stat in card.national],
        },
    )

    data_through = _data_through(conn)
    files = [
        "manifest.json",
        "city_index.json",
        "completeness.json",
        "scorecard.json",
        *(f"cities/{icao}.json" for icao in sorted(registry)),
        *(f"scorecard_cities/{icao}.json" for icao in sorted(registry)),
    ]
    _write_json(
        out_dir / "manifest.json",
        {
            "schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION,
            "generated_at": datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
            "data_through": data_through.isoformat() if data_through else None,
            "station_count": len(registry),
            "files": files,
        },
    )
